info.title: arcadia agent IPC
info.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 over NDJSON on \\.\pipe\arcadia-agent-<SID>, served by `arcadia.exe --agent`. Supersedes docs/specs/phase-3-tracker/contracts/ipc.openrpc.json (v0.4.0) as the source of truth [IPC-032]; v0.5.0 adds the game.launchUntracked, session.pause and session.resume methods, the `paused` session state (session.current and session.changed) and the error code -32005. One message per line; max 1048576 bytes per message excluding the trailing \n [IPC-012]; larger messages close only that connection, response not guaranteed [IPC-003]. Batches (JSON arrays) are rejected with a single -32600, id null [IPC-010]. Requests without id are notifications and get no response [IPC-011]. jsonrpc must be exactly "2.0" and params, if present, must be null, an array or an object, otherwise -32600 [IPC-009]. Methods without params accept params absent, null, [] or {} [IPC-008]; any non-empty array/object is -32602 [IPC-002]. Methods with params take them by name only: a positional array, a missing required member, a member of the wrong type or an unknown member is -32602 [IPC-028, IPC-035]. Requests on one connection are handled sequentially; there is no ordering guarantee between a response and notifications caused by the same request. All instants are RFC 3339 strings in UTC (Session.asOf always carries milliseconds). Pausing is triggered inside the agent (global hotkey, gamepad, system suspend) or explicitly by the client with session.pause / session.resume (reason `ui`); the agent alone computes the time, and every state change is observable through session.current and session.changed.

x-tracking.description: Agent constants (not configurable yet, not part of the wire) [SES-003..SES-013, DOM-008]. Phase 4 adds the pause constants below.

x-input.description: Phase 4 fixed defaults of the agent-side pause triggers (no settings screen yet; not part of the wire) [HOT-001, PAD-001, OVL-003]. gamepadHoldMs: user decision Q1 (2026-11-09).

methods.name: agent.heartbeat
methods.summary: Server-to-client notification every 5 s (no id, no response) [IPC-004]

methods.name: agent.shutdown
methods.summary: Server-to-client notification sent once to every connection when the agent starts an orderly shutdown, and as the first message of any connection accepted while draining (no id, no response). The server then waits up to shutdownDrainMs for the clients to close their connections before closing them itself. A client that receives it must not restart the agent; the desktop UI closes itself [EXE-013, EXE-014, EXE-015, EXE-016, EXE-017]. From this point game.launch and game.launchUntracked are refused with LaunchFailed, data.error = "agente encerrando" [AGT-011, SES-033]

params.name: reason
params.description: quit: tray "Sair"; session-end: WM_ENDSESSION; signal: Ctrl+C/SIGTERM; other: the tray loop ended on its own, or Serve ended with an error (in that case every connection is already closed, so no client receives it) [EXE-016, EXE-026]

methods.name: game.add
methods.summary: Adds an exe game to the library; the agent writes the row. Adding the same path again creates another, distinct game (no duplicate check). A stat failure other than not-exist (e.g. access denied) is -32603, logged [IPC-020, IPC-021, GAM-001..GAM-003]

params.name: path
params.description: Absolute path of an existing regular file ending in .exe (case-insensitive). Stored as filepath.Clean(path).

params.name: title
params.description: Trimmed; absent or empty after trimming means the default title (file name without .exe) [DOM-009, GAM-003]. More than maxGameTitleRunes after trimming is -32602.

methods.name: game.list
methods.summary: All games ordered by title (case-insensitive), then id [IPC-023, GAM-005]

games.description: Never null; [] when the library is empty

methods.name: game.launch
methods.summary: Launches the game inside a new Job Object and opens a tracked session; returns once the process was resumed. The existence of the game is checked before the active session; an active session is running, grace or paused [SES-031]. If the handler deadline (10 s) expires first, the result is -32603; the launch may still complete and is then reported only by session.changed [IPC-024, IPC-025, SES-001, SES-002, SES-012]

methods.name: game.launchUntracked
methods.summary: Launches the game as a plain detached process ("Sem contar tempo"): no Job Object, no play_session row, no session.changed, never shown as running, the game row is not touched; the same executable line, arguments and working directory as game.launch. Returns once CreateProcess succeeded. The existence of the game is checked before the active session. Refused with SessionActive while a tracked session is running, grace or paused or a tracked launch is in progress, and with LaunchFailed ("agente encerrando") during shutdown. If the handler deadline (10 s) expires first, the result is -32603 and the process may still have been created [IPC-033, IPC-034, IPC-035, SES-032, SES-033, SES-034]

methods.name: session.current
methods.summary: The active session (running, paused or grace), or null. activeMs/activeSeconds are measured at asOf, the agent clock reading taken when the call is handled; they do not advance in paused or grace [IPC-026, IPC-031, IPC-036]

methods.name: session.pause
methods.summary: Explicitly pauses the active session (reason `ui`): running becomes paused, time stops counting, the game processes keep running. Idempotent: an already paused session (any reason) returns success unchanged, with no write, no notification and no feedback. In grace or without a session it is refused with SessionNotPausable. Same feedback (overlay + sound) as the hotkey. The result carries the session measured at the handling instant [IPC-038, SES-035, SES-037]

methods.name: session.resume
methods.summary: Explicitly resumes a paused session (any pause reason, including sleep): paused becomes running. Idempotent: a running session returns success unchanged, with no write, no notification and no feedback. In grace or without a session it is refused with SessionNotPausable. Same feedback as the hotkey [IPC-039, SES-036, SES-037]

methods.name: session.changed
methods.summary: Server-to-client notification (no id, no response) sent to every connection once per session transition: opened (running), paused (hotkey, gamepad, session.pause or system suspend), back to running (from pause or from grace), entered grace (from running or from paused), ended or discarded; session.asOf is the instant of the transition event (for a pause, the instant of the trigger; for ended/discarded, when the grace period expired) [IPC-031, IPC-037]. Not sent for ignored pause triggers or power events, for untracked launches, for failed launches, for sessions recovered at startup, nor for the session ended by the agent shutdown (sent after Server.Close). Best effort: dropped for a connection whose output queue is full [IPC-027, IPC-029]

dataDir.description: Absolute Root resolved by the agent [DSK-006]

totalPlaySeconds.description: Sum of active_seconds of the game's ended sessions; paused time is never included [STO-016]

firstPlayedAt.description: started_at of the first counted session

lastPlayedAt.description: ended_at of the last counted session

Session.description: Snapshot of a session. activeMs and asOf come from the same agent clock reading [IPC-031]. A live display must anchor on activeMs and advance it with the client's own monotonic clock since receipt, in running only (frozen in paused and grace); it must not compute elapsed time from startedAt or by comparing asOf with the client's clock [UI-014, UI-022]. Display-only: the recorded time is the agent's.

title.description: Title of the game when the session was opened

state.description: ended/discarded only appear in session.changed [DOM-007, DOM-008, DOM-010]. paused: counting is stopped by a pause trigger or by a system suspend; the game processes keep running.

endedAt.description: null while running/paused/grace; for ended/discarded, the instant the job became empty (or the shutdown instant)

activeMs.description: Time spent in running up to asOf, in milliseconds, truncated (paused and grace excluded) [IPC-031]

asOf.description: Agent clock instant at which activeMs was measured, RFC 3339 UTC with milliseconds, always three fraction digits (Go layout 2006-01-02T15:04:05.000Z07:00, e.g. 2026-11-10T14:03:12.345Z, 2026-11-10T14:03:12.000Z) [IPC-031]

sessionId.description: 0 while the other launch is still being prepared

pid.description: Process id of the executable started by game.launchUntracked; informational, the agent keeps no handle and no state about it

error.description: Error text (Windows messages come localized); "agente encerrando" during shutdown [AGT-011]; "tipo de lançamento não suportado" for a launch_type other than exe

winError.description: Windows error code (windows.Errno), only when the failure came from a Win32 call
